description: This shell script provides command-line functions for managing OCI containers through curl-based JSON-RPC API calls. It includes functions to start, stop, list, get info/state, pause/resume containers, and execute commands inside containers, as well as an interactive command loop.
external_files: None directly referenced as files but dynamically loaded specs from './DobbySpecs/' are used

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container based on an OCI bundle directory or tarball, using curl to send a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container from a Dobby JSON spec file via curl JSON-RPC call.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by sending a JSON-RPC stop request.

methods.name: list_containers
methods.description: Lists all running containers through a JSON-RPC call.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with options, via a JSON-RPC call.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about the available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main interactive loop to accept user commands and invoke container management functions.
